This is the website for ReModel - a club for healthcare simulation enthusiasts to meet and engage in reusing open simulation models. 

Our mantra when it comes to healthcare simulation is Read, Run, Reuse. 

There is already a wealth of simulation models that are not being used to their full potential. ReModel is a project that aims to change this by making it easier to read, run, and reuse open simulation models.

If you are a healthcare analyst with an interest in simulation, or a simulation modeller who wants to learn how to better share your work, then ReModel is for you.

This website is a hub for ReModel activities. ReModel is hosted by the Strategy Unit.

Find out more about [taking part](join-us/index.qmd) and take a look at [previous and upcoming sessions](sessions/index.qmd).
